description.narrative: Insatsen omfattar stöd till en fond på EBRD - Early Transition Countries Municipal and Environmental Infrastructure. Målet är att minska miljöföroreningar och förbättra naturresursanvändningen, framförallt inom kommunal miljöinfrastuktur.Fonden används för förberedande studier och reformstöd. Under fonden ges stöd till ett flertal projekt, framförallt i Östeuropa.

The overall objective of this project is to promote the sustainable use of natural resources and protection of the environment in the Early Transition Countries. This will be done through the establishment of a Municipal Environmental Infrastructure (MEI) fund that supports the EBRD with resources for consultancy and technical assistance.

The fund objective is to finance advisory services and technical assistance for municipal environment infrastructure projects financed by EBRD and/or Sida related to EBRD's ETC initiative, with the aim of supporting environmentally, financially and socially sustainable projects. The objective was later extended to also include investment grant financing of such projects. In an effort to reduce number of trust funds between Sida and EBRD, the fund was merged with two other trust funds of similar purpose.

description.narrative:
The objective of providing financing for advisory services and technical assistance for municipal environment infrastructure projects financed by EBRD and/or Sida related to EBRD's ETC initiative, with the aim of supporting environmentally, financially and socially sustainable projects, can be said to be fulfilled. No quantifiable targets are defined for the contribution, as it is difficult to do so for these type of trust funds, where projects that will be supported are not known in beforehand. Although the objective can be said to be fulfilled, implementation of e.g. the Adjara project, has been seriously delayed.
The 2022 yearly covers two solid waste projects in Georgia. Adjara Solid Waste project implementation was completed in 2022. Although the construction of a new EU-compliant sanitary landfill was completed in March 2022, the final disbursement for works of the Sida investment grant is still pending as the Client and the Contractor has been engaged in a dispute over the final payment and the quality of works. The case is currently in arbitration. Following the completion of the arbitration process, a final payment to the Contractor will be made. The TA components funded by SWET under Adjara Solid Waste Project have been completed. Batumi Solid Waste Management project includes Technical Assistance support for a feasibility study. Despite minor delays, the assignment is progressing well and is expected to be completed in 2023.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
